questions.q: What does a blank accountCode on a company mean in practice?
o: The account cannot be reconciled against real orders in Intact
questions.e: accountCode is the Intact join key. Without it the company cannot be matched to actual trading history.

questions.q: Which field tells you who owns a company account?
o: The person who wrote the last note
questions.e: salesRep is the ownership field. The built-in Account Owner field is hidden across our views because it is misleading.

questions.q: A deal has gone quiet and will not happen. What is the correct close?
o: Delete it so it stops cluttering the pipeline
Leave it at Proposal in case they come back
Move it to Closed Lost and set a lostReason
Set the close date a year out
questions.e: Closed Lost with a reason. A closed lost deal can always be reopened if the customer returns, and the reason is what makes win-rate analysis possible.

questions.q: An email to sales@ contains a customer's decision deadline. What must happen for the CRM to hold it?
o: Nothing — the email body syncs onto the record
Someone must type it into a Note or the deal's next step
Attach the email to a Task
questions.e: Synced email shows subject and participants only. If the detail is in the body, it does not exist in the CRM until a person writes it down.
